_**The Age of A.I.**_ is an eight-episode American science documentary streaming television series narrated and hosted by American actor Robert Downey Jr. The show covers the applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in various fields, like health, robotics, space-travel, food, disaster-prevention, and others.
Each 30-45 minute episode covers several different areas of AI implementation under one broader topic.
Each episode opens with a short scene of Robert Downey Jr., in which he frames the topic of the episode.
Each episode then covers several related topics in separate parts, usually returning to the first topic during the final section of the episode.
